name: focus-group-superengine
description: Test any marketing artifact against a synthetic focus group before you ship it. Builds a reusable audience of fake-but-realistic buyers, runs them as an isolated panel, and returns a dual-axis verdict (attention vs convert), a behavioral funnel, clustered objections, and verbatim quotes — with a plain-English Teach Mode that explains the why as it goes. For coaches and creators testing names, bios, hooks, thumbnails, emails, offers, and ads.
